audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer calls Camille "he"/"his" in tldr, winCon, trading and both Do/Don't entries, and describes her threat generically as "his kit" rather than the one ability that decides the lane.
audit.why: Camille is female, and the lane's difficulty is entirely gated on Hookshot (E), 16/15/14/13/12s. Naming it with its real cooldown turns a vague warning into a schedule.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed and Hookshot's 16s rank-1 cooldown stated as the green light for stepping up; the content layer's early/mid split (Akshan owns levels 2-6, Camille reclaims at two items) is already correct and matches the mirror.

audit.why: Spikes line up with both kits: Akshan at level 2-3 (Avengerang 9s at rank 1 plus the Dirty Fighting second shot), level 6 Comeuppance (100/85/70), and Youmuu's; Camille reclaims at two items behind The Hextech Ultimatum (140/115/90).

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was stated as "nothing here works through Hookshot" without naming what Hookshot actually does to you, and Precision Protocol's true-damage second cast was never mentioned in the full layer.
audit.why: Hookshot (E) is a terrain dash with hard CC — it is the interrupt that knocks you out of Heroic Swing's arc, and Precision Protocol (Q, 9s at rank 1) is an auto-reset whose second cast carries the true damage. Both belong in the trade text.
audit.corrected: Trade lines now key off Precision Protocol's third-hit cast and Hookshot's 16s cooldown, and the Don't explicitly names Hookshot as the interrupt that ends the swing.

edits.before: He can follow the swing — trade in short bursts and save E as the exit, not the highlight reel.
edits.after: Hookshot follows your swing — trade in short bursts and save E as the exit, not the highlight reel.

edits.before: Short trades, disciplined swings, and the execute when his kit is down. Nothing here works through Hookshot — schedule your pattern around its cooldown.
edits.after: Short trades, disciplined swings, and the execute when her kit is down. Nothing works through Hookshot — it is 16s at rank 1, so schedule your pattern around it.

edits.before: Camille wins by landing Hookshot, denying your pattern, and cashing the all-in before your pattern matures.
edits.after: Camille wins by landing Hookshot, chaining Precision Protocol's true damage, and killing you before items.

edits.before: Her wall-dash stun — fight away from terrain while it is up. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Her wall-dash stun, 16s at rank 1 — fight in open lane while it is up, and step up once you have seen it spent.

edits.before: Hold E as the exit from his engage
edits.after: Hold E as the exit from her engage

edits.before: Q for both boomerang passes, double-auto the three-hit proc, and sprint-shield away on the passive MS before his trade pattern starts.
edits.after: Q for both boomerang passes, double-auto the three-hit proc, then leave on the cancelled-shot move speed before her Precision Protocol lands.

edits.before: The swing has one interrupt answer — using E as an entrance instead of an exit hands him that answer for free.
edits.after: Hookshot is the one interrupt that answers the swing — using E as an entrance, not an exit, hands her that answer.

edits.before: Q for both boomerang passes, double-auto the three-hit proc, and sprint-shield away on the passive MS before his trade pattern starts.
edits.after: Q for both boomerang passes, double-auto the three-hit proc, then leave on the cancelled-shot move speed before her Precision Protocol lands.

edits.before: Good trade: Q for both boomerang passes, double-auto the three-hit proc, and sprint-shield away on the passive MS before his trade pattern starts. Bad trade: Swinging INTO a loaded kit for style points — one interrupt mid-arc and you're a stationary marksman in melee range.
edits.after: Good trade: Q for both boomerang passes, double-auto the three-hit proc, then leave on the cancelled-shot speed before her Precision Protocol lands. Bad trade: Swinging INTO a loaded Hookshot for style points — one stun mid-arc and you're a stationary marksman in melee range.

edits.before: - Camille Hookshot: matchup-defining — Her wall-dash stun — fight away from terrain while it is up. It governs your forward steps. - E swing spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Camille Hookshot: matchup-defining — her wall-dash stun, 16s at rank 1 and 12s at rank 5. It governs your forward steps. - E swing spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.

notes: MC_WR_TABLES.akshan.camille is 45.78 while the packet reports 60.87% over 23 games — the two sources disagree and WR tables are not writable, so this is flagged rather than changed. content whys[4] claims Comeuppance scales 'up to 200%' with missing health; Riot's description only says 'based on missing health', so the number was left alone and logged as unverified.
